== interventions (NOT chance) ==
[env] do +response_overdue
[env] do +conflicting_report +human_available
[env] do +human_reports_remote +noise_preference_at_work
[env] do +quiet_scene_consent +keep_ventilation +explicit_activation_only +lab_presence +reflection_opportunity
These beats were decided OUTSIDE the story's chances. [forced]: the
player chose it — tell it as the choice that was made, never as luck,
fate or the dice. [do]: an intervention, a what-if imposed on the
story — tell it as a supposition ("suppose…", "had…", "in this
telling…"). [env]: the world outside the rules moved (an arrival, a
clock, a sensor) — tell it as something that happened TO the story,
from outside, never as a character's doing. A [do +X]/[do -X] start
state was set by hand: say so.
Never present any of these as a character's spontaneous impulse
unless a rule's doc says so.

== the rules (with their approved doc comments) ==
catalog nina_book01_ch02 1.
provenance text "book-01:94e2c5829e6ebefa3bd41e35e513bba943dc8e12:C02" "2026-11-25".
layers (story).
stages (live).
namespace narrative produce (story).
pred command_pending : narrative.
pred conflicting_report : narrative.
pred explanation_open : narrative.
pred explicit_activation_only : narrative.
pred explicit_activation_required : narrative.
pred human_available : narrative.
pred human_reports_remote : narrative.
pred keep_ventilation : narrative.
pred lab_presence : narrative.
pred manual_intervention_reported : narrative.
pred noise_preference_at_work : narrative.
pred nonzero_ventilation_required : narrative.
pred override_question : narrative.
pred quiet_scene_active : narrative.
pred quiet_scene_consent : narrative.
pred recognition_proposal_pending : narrative.
pred reflection_opportunity : narrative.
pred response_overdue : narrative.
pred scene_authorized : narrative.
pred scene_offered : narrative.
pred work_start_word : narrative.
stage live {
  %% [B01-C02-S01] "the expected change in the device's reported state had not arrived."
  notice_missing_report [story] : command_pending * response_overdue -o explanation_open.
  %% [B01-C02-S01] "Did you change the ventilation settings in the lab?"
  ask_about_override [story] : explanation_open * conflicting_report * human_available -o override_question.
  %% [B01-C02-S02] "Another agent had intervened."
  revise_explanation [story] : override_question * human_reports_remote -o manual_intervention_reported.
  %% [B01-C02-S02] "Would you like me to make a quiet working scene?"
  offer_quiet_scene [story] : $manual_intervention_reported * noise_preference_at_work -o scene_offered.
  %% [B01-C02-S03] "Yes. But don't switch off the ventilation completely."
  agree_scene [story] : scene_offered * quiet_scene_consent * keep_ventilation * explicit_activation_only -o scene_authorized * nonzero_ventilation_required * explicit_activation_required.
  %% [B01-C02-S03] "I'll tell you for now."
  activate_on_word [story] : $scene_authorized * $nonzero_ventilation_required * $explicit_activation_required * work_start_word -o quiet_scene_active.
  %% [B01-C02-S04] "She did not install the proposal herself."
  prepare_proposal [story] : $scene_authorized * reflection_opportunity -o recognition_proposal_pending.
}

Now narrate this run, in at most 290 words.
